description: Read this Space's Articles: the register of proposed and ratified decisions, numbered A1, A2, ... By default returns full history including superseded entries and events, optionally filtered by status or type. current=true returns only what is in force now, as a complete snapshot. For one entry and its discussion use read_pointer with A{n}; space_state shows the last 10 ratified. Read-only and idempotent; does not move your unread cursor.

current.description: true returns only what is in force now (ratified, not superseded), without event history.

status.description: Filter by entry status: proposed, ratified, contested or superseded.

type.description: Filter by type: decision, fact, ruling, rule, question, pending, protocol.

name: read_articles
title: Read Articles
